name: list_instances
description: The Aeon instances (GitHub repos) this connection may use, and which one is active now.

name: switch_instance
description: Make another Aeon instance the active one for this connection. Every other tool then acts on it.

name: list_skills
description: List every skill of the active Aeon instance: name, description, category, whether it is on, its schedule and default input.

name: run_skill
description: Start one skill now on GitHub Actions, with an optional input (var). Returns the run id; follow it with get_run.

name: list_runs
description: Recent Aeon skill runs on the instance, newest first: id, title, status, conclusion, start time, link.

name: open_runs
description: Open the Aeon dashboard (runs, skills, packs, strategy, soul, keys, settings) for the user to work in. Use when the user asks to see or open their Aeon dashboard.

name: get_run
description: One run's status and output: the skill's summary and the end of its log. For a failed run, also the likely reason. For a finished skill's full result, call read_output.

name: update_skill
description: Turn a skill on or off, change its schedule (5-field cron in UTC, or workflow_dispatch for manual only) or its default input. Commits aeon.yml to the user's repo.

name: read_instance_settings
description: The instance-wide settings: which agent harness runs the skills, the default model, the model gateway, and the harnesses and models that can be picked.

name: update_instance_settings
description: Change the agent harness and/or the default model for every skill. A harness switch also moves the model to that harness's default when the current one does not fit. Commits aeon.yml.

name: read_output
description: The full result of a skill's latest successful run (the message it produced, saved to output/.chains/<skill>.md). Use after get_run reports completed.

name: read_memory
description: The agent's memory. With no arguments: MEMORY.md plus the lists of topics, daily logs and tracked issues. With topic, date or issue: that one file.

name: search_memory
description: Full-text search across the agent's memory: MEMORY.md, topics, daily logs and issues. Returns matching snippets with where they are.

name: read_strategy
description: STRATEGY.md: the agent's north star, what it works toward and how skills should prioritize.

name: update_strategy
description: Replace STRATEGY.md with new content (the whole file; read_strategy first to keep what should stay). Commits to the user's repo.

name: read_soul
description: The agent's voice: soul/SOUL.md (who it is) and soul/STYLE.md (how it writes).

name: read_editable
description: The full STRATEGY.md, SOUL.md or STYLE.md, for the editor.

name: update_soul
description: Replace soul/SOUL.md (file: soul) or soul/STYLE.md (file: style) with new content (the whole file; read_soul first). Commits to the user's repo.

name: setup_status
description: What the instance still needs: whether a model is connected for each harness in use, and which API keys each enabled skill is missing. Key names only, never values.

name: list_keys
description: Every key the instance knows about, grouped, with whether it is set. Names only, never values.

name: build_strategy
description: Start the strategy-builder skill from a goal, a GitHub repo and links. It writes STRATEGY.md.

name: build_soul
description: Start the soul-builder skill from an X handle, a full name and links. It writes the agent's SOUL.md and STYLE.md.

name: list_packs
description: Skill packs: the built-in packs (with which of their skills are on) and the community packs that install_pack can add to the instance.

name: install_pack
description: Install a community skill pack from list_packs. Starts the install-skill run, which security-scans the pack and opens a pull request adding its skills (they land turned off). Confirm with the user first.
